episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Kang Seong-jae enlists in the army as a cook and receives mysterious game-like commands that appear only to him.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Facing reassignment, Seong-jae must complete a high-stakes cooking quest within 72 hours to secure his role as military cook.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Seong-jae must improvise a daring dish during a surprise inspection to save his military kitchen.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Seong-jae's culinary success lifts unit morale but triggers professional jealousy and tension after an unexpected encounter.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Stripped of his skills while on leave, Seong-jae works as a kitchen assistant to save his mother's business and discovers a secret ingredient.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Seong-jae rallies the troops with an improvised arancini, but encounters danger after overhearing Captain Lee's plot.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: A quest challenges Seong-jae to turn his rival, Sergeant Kim Kwan-cheol, into an ally.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Seong-jae navigates rising tensions and a sudden offer to join the officer's mess.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Seong-jae enters the officer's mess and completes a crucial quest.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Seong-jae begins his final quest and participates in a cooking competition.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Seong-jae teams up with Sergeant Yoon and Sergeant Kim, as they go head-to-head with Lee Ho-young.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: As Seong-jae emerges as the contest winner, a brand new quest comes to light, challenging his skills once again.
